shops.name: Cool Paws
shops.audience: apartment dog owners in hot cities whose floors bake by noon
shops.headline: A cool mat your dog actually lies on — and a bandana that does not sag soggy
shops.lede: Gel core under woven nylon, stays 6–8°C below room temperature for two hours. Machine-washable cover, no electricity, folds flat. Sold with a reversible swim bandana and paw balm for hot asphalt.
shops.note: Cold water + 10 min soak = mat depth back. That is the whole routine.

products.name: Cool mat (M/L)
products.blurb: Gel core, woven cover. M 60×45cm, L 90×60cm. The bandana is for the walk back.

shops.name: Caffeine Lab
shops.audience: people who bought a pour-over set and now want a ritual that tastes like one
shops.headline: A kettle that stops pouring when it should, and a brewer that keeps the ritual short
shops.lede: Gooseneck kettle with stop-at-temperature, 600ml glass brewer, 100 filters. Two pour rounds, 2:45 total — the two minutes your office coffee machine spends burning itself. Starter kit ships as one box, one order.
shops.note: Kit includes 100 filters and the 2:45 recipe card on the box.

products.name: Gooseneck kettle
products.blurb: Takes 2:40. Stop-at-temperature, hold. One pouring arm, no splash.

products.name: Glass brewer
products.blurb: 600 ml, pour-over. Fits a 300 ml mug and a 500 ml carafe.

products.name: 100 filters
products.blurb: Unglazed, oxygen-bleached. One box = 100 brews of clean cup.

shops.name: Desk Hush

shops.note: Riser and phone bridge ship in one box. No tools.

products.name: Birch laptop riser

shops.name: Pod Shed
shops.audience: podcast and YouTube hobbyists recording in rented flats with thin walls
shops.kicker: Quiet on the track, done cheap
shops.headline: A boom arm that gets the mic off the desk — and a foam hood that kills the boom
shops.lede: Gas-spring boom arm holds a condenser steady without drift; a foam shock-mount and pop hood sit between you and the neighbours. For clean takes in a small room, not a studio.
shops.note: No drivers, no software. The win is mechanical isolation — the boom clamps, the hood damps, the desk stops drumming through the track.
shops.ship: 3–6 days, DHL tracked from DE warehouse
